patch_description: The current program regressed to 4 distinct parameters (ry_a, ry_b, rz, zz_ring), scoring 0.70, worse than the prior 2-parameter design that scored 0.74. Since parameter economy dominates the score, I revert to the proven 2-parameter structure (single "ry_a" pre-rotation + single "theta" shared across all RZ/ZZ/XX layers), and apply the recommended enhancement: insert a YY nearest-neighbor ring (wires [0,1],[1,2],...,[7,0]) sharing the same "theta" parameter immediately after the existing XX ring. This adds an orthogonal Y-basis coupling to complement the existing Z and X couplings, enriching the reachable entangled-state space (helping separate the hardest validation group) without introducing any new trainable parameter, consistent with the pattern that added the XX ring in the 0.74-scoring ancestor.
